name: Retro Shiva: Persinger Session run clockwise (Murphy's reading)
origin: Todd Murphy (Shiva 'Persinger Session'); 'Retro Shiva' after an unsigned practitioner's testimonial on Murphy's Shiva page (by 2011), placed with the page's link to the DeepFocus Institute, read as clockwise running by Murphy (2013), who credits the Swiss DeepFocus group (Rolf Boesch)
summary: The Shiva 'Persinger Session' (seven applications of a 40 Hz stand-in for the chirp, 43 min) run clockwise instead of counter-clockwise, which is how Murphy reads the 'Retro Shiva' of a practitioner's testimonial. The practitioner tried it for people 'not able to come out of their energy state'. The reported benefits are testimonials, and the vendor's safety page says not to experiment with coil arrangements.
notes: The idea is from a testimonial on the vendor's Shiva page: 'I turn the cap and apply the 40hz Chirp Signal (Persinger session)' in 2011, 'turn the cap (around)' today (shiva/index.htm); it does not mention clockwise rotation. The clockwise reading is Murphy's: 'using clockwise rotation around the head instead of the usual counterclockwise configuration' (sacredneurology.com 2013). The German DeepFocus report he credits mentions neither clockwise nor retro use (Boesch pp.1-2). A 180-degree turn of the cap would keep the counter-clockwise stepping. This file follows Murphy's reading: the timing of murphy-shiva-persinger-session, stepped clockwise from Fp2 (a project choice): Fp2, FT8, TP8, O2, O1, TP7, FT7, Fp1. One coil per position instead of Shiva's coil pairs: timing kept, half the arc covered. Block lengths (7 x 5 min), the 80-s silences, the step ramps and the plain 40 Hz sine for the chirp are this project's choices. Blocks 1 to 6 step 10 to 20 ... 20 to 30 ms per coil, after a lecture example with no unit named; block 7 is the lab's +20 ms configuration, 100 to 240 ms (Richards 2002 p.4 [674], Table 1). Field at the lab ring: 5 to 10 uT at the scalp (Richards 2002 p.3 [673]), 0.5 to 1.5 uT near the scalp (Tsang 2004 p.5 [1187]). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. At 1 uT that is about 24 uT at the scalp. The reported benefits are testimonials, one from a single Kriya-yoga user (Murphy: 'only one case'). Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). The vendor's safety page says 'Counterclockwise is usually the more pleasant direction' and 'Don't experiment with new arrangements for the coils' (shiva_safety.htm, rules 6-7): stop if the clockwise run feels unpleasant. Not for people with epilepsy.
setting: Dark, quiet room, eyes closed, seated or lying relaxed. For the Persinger Session Murphy advises against spiritual practice or psychic exercises during the session ('daydreaming is better than meditation') and suggests geomagnetically quiet days for effects during the session.
schedule: At most once a week, like the counter-clockwise Persinger Session. Murphy says the Swiss averaged 4 sessions per subject; their German report speaks of about 100 people with five or more sessions.
